## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or capability.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or unmet need? (e.g., "I want to integrate a barometer sensor to detect altitude changes during falls...")

## Proposed Capability & Architecture
- **Target Tier**: (Level 0 Baseline / Level 1 Kinetic / Level 2 Specialist / Level 3 Fusion / Level 4 Reasoning)
- **Sensor Input Modality**: (e.g., Barometer, Audio, Thermal, Optical)
- **Computational Cost Profile**: (Low / Medium / High compute)
- **Escalation & Gating Trigger**: When should this expert run?

## Alternative Solutions Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Zero-Mock Verification Plan
How will this feature be verified on physical hardware or through rigorous automated test suites without mock data?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or references here.
